note: The Editor's Rating, one per tried model, written by the editor and read by ratings.py and surveytest.py. The generator never writes this file; an unattended run carries the previous rating forward with its date showing. Good and Acceptable are in the manifest, Goods above Acceptables; Marginal and Poor are out. A standing disqualifier (see ratings.py) holds a model out whatever its rating, and a model whose only runs are baselines cannot be rated. A null rating is unrated, not Poor. See docs/decisions.md, "The Editor's Rating replaces the status markers".
